MAPGEN-011: geometry substrate ACQUIRED (HALC v15.0) but 1756 political evidence gap -> SOURCE_GAP; no control rows exist here and their absence means UNKNOWN, never neutral.
MAPGEN-012: Meissen/Electoral-Saxony core digitised from the 1756 Vaugondy sheet. Hexes outside the digitised feature have NO control row and therefore remain UNKNOWN, never neutral.

MAPGEN-018R: the MAPGEN-018 georeference was built on a grid reconstructed from border ticks, not on observed control points, so the status is downgraded to GEOREFERENCE_PROVISIONAL. Independent checks on 5 towns give a median of 9.3 km and a maximum of 28.6 km with a systematic component. No geometry, no membership, no control. Absence still means UNKNOWN.

Great Britain main island: every hex of the MAIN-ISLAND scope is evaluated on exact land intersection. Offshore components (Hebrides, Orkney, Shetland, Anglesey, Wight, Arran, Islay, Isle of Man, Channel Islands) are identified and excluded, so this is TERRITORY_PARTIAL and the polity as a whole is NOT COMPLETE.

Ireland main island: every hex of the MAIN-ISLAND scope is evaluated on exact land intersection. Offshore components (Hebrides, Orkney, Shetland, Anglesey, Wight, Arran, Islay, Isle of Man, Channel Islands) are identified and excluded, so this is TERRITORY_PARTIAL and the polity as a whole is NOT COMPLETE.

Sicily main island: every hex of the MAIN-ISLAND scope is evaluated on exact land intersection. Offshore components (Aeolian Islands, Egadi, Pantelleria, Ustica and Malta) are identified and excluded. For Sardinia the mainland Savoyard possessions (Piedmont, Savoy, Nice) are also outside scope: Piedmont, Savoy and Nice belong to the same actor, pol_sardinia (Savoy-Piedmont), but are UNASSESSED and NOT_PRODUCED by that stage - a coverage statement, not a redefinition of the actor. TERRITORY_PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.

Sardinia main island: every hex of the MAIN-ISLAND scope is evaluated on exact land intersection. Offshore components (La Maddalena archipelago, Sant'Antioco, San Pietro and Asinara) are identified and excluded. For Sardinia the mainland Savoyard possessions (Piedmont, Savoy, Nice) are also outside scope: Piedmont, Savoy and Nice belong to the same actor, pol_sardinia (Savoy-Piedmont), but are UNASSESSED and NOT_PRODUCED by that stage - a coverage statement, not a redefinition of the actor. TERRITORY_PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.

Iceland main island: every hex of the MAIN-ISLAND scope is evaluated on exact land intersection under the Danish-Norwegian crown. The Faroes, Vestmannaeyjar and the smaller offshore components are identified and excluded; Denmark, Norway, Schleswig, Holstein and Greenland are outside this stage's scope entirely. TERRITORY_PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.

Malta main island: exact land intersection under the Order of Saint John, authorised by the 1530 privilege of Charles V. Comino and Filfla are not named in that instrument and are withheld. TERRITORY_PARTIAL.
Gozo: authorised as a separate component of the same actor because the 1530 privilege names it. Coverage is partial for the same reasons as Malta. TERRITORY_PARTIAL.

Spain, Iberian mainland: safe interior only and FROZEN by MAPGEN-027 - 5439 rows (5431 hexes and 8 coastal LAND_FRAGMENTs), with the hex set identical to MAPGEN-026. Gibraltar, Andorra, Llivia, the Couto Misto and Ceuta are withheld by name. The Balearics, the Canaries, Ceuta, Melilla and everything overseas are UNASSESSED. TERRITORY_PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.

Portugal, Iberian mainland: safe interior only, and still THIN. MAPGEN-027 raised it from 26 to 124 rows (123 hexes and 1 coastal LAND_FRAGMENT) by resolving two questions of evidence rather than by better cartography: the Algarve is Portuguese on institutional grounds (one chancery, one law book, one comarca magistracy, one decima), and the unowned strips between Portugal's own traced cells are Portuguese where the corridor between them contains no cell of another crown. The country is about 150 km wide against a measured 34.61 km positional error, so most of it is still inside its own uncertainty band. A larger-scale 1762 Sanson/Vaugondy sheet has been acquired and audited but not yet georeferenced. Madeira, the Azores and the overseas empire are UNASSESSED. TERRITORY_PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.

The 345 Iberian hexes that carry mainland land but are not canonical terrestrial hexes now address that land as LAND_FRAGMENTs: 9 CONTROLLED and 336 explicitly UNRESOLVED. The OCEAN parent hexes remain unowned, and 139 of these hexes also hold land of other physical components - up to 103 of them in one hex - which is measured and left unowned.
